selection: Four formats with fixed manual estimates. Three selected completed application jobs have recorded timing; Product Demo uses a user-provided 20-minute 16-second generation time. Not a representative sample or a success-rate study.
timing: Recorded jobs use job creation to saved completion, rounded up to a whole second, including queued time, retry attempts and gaps within that job. Product Demo uses an approximate generation time rather than a matched job record. All generation times exclude brief preparation before submission and final human review.
manualMethod: Illustrative planning estimates, not timed human trials. One editor familiar with the product, existing templates, a short script, screen recording, voiceover, captions, layout and one review pass. No custom animation or approval rounds. Estimates are not industry averages.
limitations: Prepared application, templates and recording workflows were already available. Setup, workflow authoring, earlier development/debugging and later revisions are not included. Retries may reuse completed work. Human intervention was not timed separately. These different tasks are not a controlled quality-matched comparison. No claim of labor hours saved or automatic conversion of one video into three.

runs.label: Product Demo
runs.note: User-provided estimates: generation is 20 minutes 16 seconds, compared with about one hour to professionally produce a 90-second continuous walkthrough with narration, captions and smooth zoom. Neither estimate is a matched timed trial, and the stage breakdown is illustrative rather than individually measured.
